topic: Uses and safety of electricity in everyday life
key_concepts: Some devices use batteries as their electricity source
Some devices plug into electrical outlets
Some devices can use both batteries and electrical outlets
Electricity is used for cooling rooms
Electricity is used for heating water
Electricity is used for cooking food
Electricity can power toys to move
Electrical devices should be kept away from water
Damaged cords should be repaired by a licensed electrician
Appliances should be unplugged after use
